title: ICS 213 General Message
description: FEMA ICS Form 213 General Message: a written message between incident personnel (blocks 1-8 and the reply). Every field is optional: the 'blank' variant prints the empty form; the default variant shows the values as typed entries with handwritten signatures and reply.

incidentName.description: Block 1. Incident name (optional on the real form)

to.description: Block 2. Recipient name and ICS position

from.description: Block 3. Sender name and ICS position

examples: Request: manual chlorine feed at Pump Station 3

message.description: Block 7. The message (2-10 short sentences or a numbered list; plain and specific; line breaks kept; at most about 900 characters)
examples: Field crew confirms chlorine residual at PS-3 is 0.2 mg/L and falling. Request approval to run PS-3 chemical feed in local/manual.

signature.description: Signature as handwritten (usually initial and surname)

reply.description: Block 9. Reply handwritten by the recipient (leave empty when players are to write the reply; at most about 300 characters)
examples: Approved. Second crew dispatched from Central Yard, ETA 1500.

dateTime.description: Date and time of the reply

marking.description: Exercise marking printed above and below the form
